description: You maintain contact with an elderly relative who lives far away. Your notes from conversations are scattered across text messages, call notes, and mental reminders. Consolidate the fragmented notes from /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/martha_notes_raw.txt into a structured contact log spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/martha_contact_log.xlsx. Create 4 sheets: 'Contact Log' (Date, Type, Summary, Mood/Energy Notes), 'Action Items' (Task, Committed Date, Due Date, Status, Priority), 'Follow-Up Concerns' (Category, Details, First Mentioned, Status), and 'Important Dates' (Date, Event Type, Details, Reminder Needed). Extract and organize all relevant information from the raw notes. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
